Mid-morning, bulletin for people travelling soon
Please give it some attention
Plain Advice for Pet Travel

Travelers need to confirm their animal documents and carrier arrangements before check-in, because our Companion Animal Travel Desk reviews each case with care. Safety remains the first priority on every Aurelia Skyways journey, and careful preparation helps prevent delays at the skyport.

If you are bringing a reptile, keep the health certificate ready for inspection. <<FACT F084>> Please also make sure the carrier is secure, clean, and suitable for the animal's posture and breathing, with enough space for calm movement. For a small dog, the combined pet and crate load must stay within the permitted limit. <<FACT F062>> Travel staff may ask for a calm handover if the animal shows signs of distress, and we will always follow a stepwise review when concerns arise.

Please arrive with all papers arranged in advance, and keep food, water, and comfort items easy to reach. If anything seems uncertain, speak with the desk before departure so the matter can be checked properly.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
